executive_summary: insertCoordinationRow (lib/coordinator/dispatch.cjs) signals a DELIVERED-but-parked outcome by THROWING an error carrying landed=true and parkedRowId, at TWO call sites (DISPATCH_BACKPRESSURE line 1321, and DISPATCH_ALREADY_DELIVERED line 1565 -- the QF-20260902-160 dedup guard). A caller that treats any thrown error as "nothing landed" resends, duplicating a row that already delivered. This has caused measured production duplicates: 6 duplicate message bodies / 13 rows in 24h, 4 pairs under 3 seconds apart. Of 25 durable callers (LEAD-phase VALIDATION-confirmed count; 38 invocation lines), only 3 correctly branch on the thrown flag, and 11 are CLI entrypoints whose process.exit(1) path is the actual mechanism that produced the original incident (a shell || fallback resending on exit status, not on message text). This PRD delivers an ADDITIVE result-field fix scoped strictly to the two landed=true throw sites (every other throw path in the function must keep throwing, per the LEAD-phase VALIDATION inverse-hazard finding), migrates the CLI exit-code mapping at all 11 entrypoints, and propagates the new field to the remaining 8 non-CLI lib/ callers.

functional_requirements.title: Additive result fields on insertCoordinationRow + shared isDeliveredDispatchError predicate
functional_requirements.description: insertCoordinationRow currently returns the raw PostgREST {data,error} object (dispatch.cjs:1730) for the ordinary success/DB-error path, and THROWS for the two landed=true cases (DISPATCH_BACKPRESSURE at line ~1321, DISPATCH_ALREADY_DELIVERED at line ~1565), each carrying error.code, error.landed=true, error.parkedRowId. Change ONLY these two throw sites to instead RETURN an object that ADDS landed/parkedRowId/code fields onto the existing {data,error} shape -- never restructure or replace it, since 16 durable callers depend on the current {data,error} shape for the ordinary path. Export a new isDeliveredDispatchError(resultOrError) predicate (usable against either the new returned shape or, defensively, a legacy caught exception during the migration window) that both codes satisfy. Every OTHER throw path in insertCoordinationRow (the ~6 other error codes and ~6 fail-closed assert* guards) is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE and must continue to throw unchanged -- a blanket throw-to-return migration would silently convert genuine failures into accepted return values for the 22 non-branching durable callers, inverting this SD's own defect (duplicated content) into a worse one (silently dropped content).
acceptance_criteria: insertCoordinationRow no longer throws for DISPATCH_BACKPRESSURE or DISPATCH_ALREADY_DELIVERED; both return an object with the existing {data,error} fields plus landed=true and parkedRowId, verified by reading the post-fix source at both call sites

Every other throw path in insertCoordinationRow (confirmed via the LEAD-phase Explore exit-path inventory: ~13 distinct throw codes plus 6 fail-closed assert* guards) is unchanged and still throws -- verified by a diff review showing no other throw statement was touched
isDeliveredDispatchError() is exported from dispatch.cjs and returns true for both codes, false for every other throw code and for the ordinary success/DB-error return shape

The 3 durable callers that already branch correctly (scripts/adam-advisory.cjs, scripts/solomon-advisory.cjs, scripts/worker-signal.cjs's shared reportDispatchError, 4 call sites) are migrated from catching e.landed on a thrown exception to reading result.landed on the returned object, with no change to their observable delivered/not-delivered outcome

tests/unit/coordinator/dispatch-send-backpressure.test.js and dispatch-correlation-dedupe.test.js (existing coverage for both throw paths) are updated to assert the new return shape and pass; a mutation test that reverts one call site back to throwing is caught by at least one updated test

functional_requirements.title: CLI exit-code mapping for the 11 CLI-entrypoint durable callers
functional_requirements.description: 11 of the 25 durable insertCoordinationRow callers are CLI entrypoints with process.exit(1) paths on a caught error; only the 3 already-correct files map a delivered/parked outcome to exit 0. This is the actual mechanism that produced the original incident: the observed production resend fired on a shell || fallback reading the EXIT STATUS, never on the thrown message text. Using FR-1's isDeliveredDispatchError() predicate, update all 11 CLI entrypoints to exit 0 when the result is a delivered/parked outcome, collapsing the 3 existing hand-rolled if(e.landed) exit(0) copies onto the shared predicate.
acceptance_criteria: All 11 CLI-entrypoint durable callers exit 0 (not 1) when insertCoordinationRow reports a delivered/parked outcome via FR-1's new return shape, verified by a synthetic-outcome test per entrypoint or a shared harness covering all 11
The 3 existing hand-rolled if(e.landed) exit(0) implementations are refactored to call the shared isDeliveredDispatchError() predicate instead of duplicating the check

A regression test reproduces the original incident's shape (a delivered/parked outcome followed by a check of process.exitCode) and asserts exit 0 across all 11 sites -- closing the exact defect class that caused the measured 6 duplicate bodies / 13 rows in the original 24h window

functional_requirements.title: lib/ propagation for the 8 non-CLI durable callers
functional_requirements.description: Propagate FR-1's additive result fields into the 8 non-CLI durable lib/ callers (no exit code involved, no migration needed for CLI semantics). This includes 3 files currently mis-surfacing a successful park as an outright failure today -- not merely failing to detect it, but actively reporting the wrong outcome: coordinator-capacity-forecast.mjs (catch -> return false / process.exitCode=1 on any throw), coordination-events.cjs's emitInertWorkerAlert, and sweep-findings-sink.cjs (both collapse to {ok:false,error} on any throw) -- plus kill-switch-writer.cjs, which does not even catch today and propagates the exception uncaught.
acceptance_criteria: All 8 non-CLI durable lib/ callers correctly distinguish a delivered/parked outcome from a genuine failure using FR-1's return shape / isDeliveredDispatchError() predicate

coordinator-capacity-forecast.mjs, coordination-events.cjs's emitInertWorkerAlert, and sweep-findings-sink.cjs no longer report {ok:false,error} for a delivered/parked outcome -- verified by a test asserting each returns/reports success (or an equivalent non-failure signal) for that case
kill-switch-writer.cjs adds a catch (or equivalent handling) so a delivered/parked outcome from insertCoordinationRow no longer propagates as an uncaught exception

technical_requirements.title: Return contract is additive-only, never a restructure
technical_requirements.description: insertCoordinationRow's existing {data,error} return shape (dispatch.cjs:1730) must remain byte-for-byte compatible for every non-landed-true code path. FR-1's new fields are added alongside it, never replacing it. 16 durable callers depend on the current shape and are out of migration scope for this SD.

technical_requirements.title: Scope strictly bounded to the two landed=true throw sites
technical_requirements.description: DISPATCH_BACKPRESSURE and DISPATCH_ALREADY_DELIVERED are the ONLY two throw sites in scope for the throw-to-return migration. The ~6 other error codes and ~6 fail-closed assert* guards in the same function must continue to throw, unchanged, for the life of this SD -- confirmed by the LEAD-phase VALIDATION inverse-hazard analysis (evidence ede9ddad-ecc2-4239-adef-908000ed0e0b).

technical_requirements.title: No schema/migration, no new table
technical_requirements.description: This is a pure application-layer signaling-shape change inside lib/coordinator/dispatch.cjs and its 25 durable callers. No database schema change is required or in scope.

risks.risk: A blanket throw-to-return migration across ALL of insertCoordinationRow's throw codes (not just the two landed=true ones) would silently convert genuine failures into accepted return values for the 22 non-branching durable callers -- inverting this SD's defect (duplicated content) into a worse one (silently dropped content).
risks.mitigation: TR-2 scopes the migration strictly to DISPATCH_BACKPRESSURE and DISPATCH_ALREADY_DELIVERED; every other throw path is explicitly excluded and verified unchanged in code review.

risks.risk: Restructuring insertCoordinationRow's return shape (rather than adding fields) would silently break the 16 durable callers that depend on the current raw {data,error} shape for the ordinary success/DB-error path.
risks.mitigation: TR-1 mandates additive-only fields; a diff review confirms the existing {data,error} keys are untouched.

risks.risk: Fixing only the JS-level throw/return shape without updating the 11 CLI entrypoints' exit-code mapping would leave the original incident's actual trigger mechanism (a shell || fallback reading exit status) unaddressed.
risks.mitigation: FR-2 makes the CLI exit-code mapping a first-class, independently-verified functional requirement, not a trivial follow-on.

test_scenarios.scenario: A caller hits DISPATCH_BACKPRESSURE (target already at the unanswered-directed-row limit)
test_scenarios.expected: insertCoordinationRow returns (does not throw) with landed=true and a parkedRowId; a CLI-entrypoint caller exits 0; a lib/ caller does not report a failure.

test_scenarios.scenario: A caller retries with the SAME correlation_id as an already-delivered row (DISPATCH_ALREADY_DELIVERED)
test_scenarios.expected: insertCoordinationRow returns (does not throw) with landed=true and a parkedRowId pointing at the existing delivered row; behavior mirrors the DISPATCH_BACKPRESSURE case.

test_scenarios.scenario: A caller hits any OTHER throw code (e.g. a kill-switch code, a target-validation code) or a fail-closed assert* guard
test_scenarios.expected: insertCoordinationRow still throws, unchanged from today; a CLI-entrypoint caller still exits 1; a lib/ caller still reports the failure.

test_scenarios.scenario: The ordinary success or DB-error path (no landed=true condition)
test_scenarios.expected: insertCoordinationRow returns the same {data,error} shape as today, byte-for-byte, for every field a caller currently reads.

consumers: 25 durable callers of insertCoordinationRow across scripts/ and lib/ (11 CLI entrypoints, 8 non-CLI lib/ modules, 3 already-correct callers, plus 3 non-branching lib/ modules that currently mis-surface a delivered/parked outcome as a failure)
The broader fleet coordination-delivery pipeline: every worker/coordinator/Adam/Solomon send path that routes through insertCoordinationRow
dependencies: QF-20260902-160's existing correlation_id dedup guard (dispatch.cjs:1555-1569), which this SD's DISPATCH_ALREADY_DELIVERED fix builds directly on top of
The 2 existing test files (tests/unit/coordinator/dispatch-send-backpressure.test.js, dispatch-correlation-dedupe.test.js) that already cover both throw paths structurally
data_contracts: insertCoordinationRow's return shape: additive fields only (landed, parkedRowId) alongside the existing {data,error} object -- no restructure, no schema/migration change
observability_rollout: Verified via the existing session_coordination duplicate-body detection method (group rows by exact body text within a 24h window) used to originally measure this defect -- a post-ship absence of new duplicate pairs is the rollout signal
The 11 CLI entrypoints' exit-code behavior is directly observable via their existing process exit codes in fleet worker/coordinator logs

system_architecture.summary: A single shared function (lib/coordinator/dispatch.cjs's insertCoordinationRow) changes its signaling shape for exactly two outcome codes from throw to additive-return; 25 durable callers across scripts/ and lib/ are migrated to consume the new field via a shared predicate.

components.name: lib/coordinator/dispatch.cjs
components.change: Two throw sites (DISPATCH_BACKPRESSURE, DISPATCH_ALREADY_DELIVERED) become additive returns; new exported isDeliveredDispatchError() predicate.

components.name: scripts/adam-advisory.cjs, scripts/solomon-advisory.cjs, scripts/worker-signal.cjs
components.change: Migrate from catching e.landed to reading result.landed (3 already-correct files, 6 call sites).

components.name: 11 CLI-entrypoint durable callers
components.change: Exit 0 (not 1) on a delivered/parked result via the shared predicate.

components.name: 8 non-CLI lib/ durable callers
components.change: Propagate/consume the new result fields; 4 of these currently mis-surface or drop the outcome entirely.

implementation_approach.summary: Land FR-1 first (the core signaling-shape change plus the 3 already-correct callers' migration) as an independently shippable PR, then FR-2 (CLI exit-code mapping) and FR-3 (lib/ propagation) as separate, smaller PRs consuming FR-1's exported predicate.
steps: FR-1: change the two throw sites to additive returns; export isDeliveredDispatchError(); migrate the 3 already-correct callers; update/extend the two existing dispatch test files.
FR-2: update the 11 CLI entrypoints' exit-code mapping using the shared predicate; add regression coverage reproducing the original incident's shape.
FR-3: propagate the new fields into the 8 non-CLI lib/ callers, correcting the 4 that currently mis-surface or drop a delivered/parked outcome.

smoke_test_steps.instruction: Run tests/unit/coordinator/dispatch-send-backpressure.test.js and dispatch-correlation-dedupe.test.js after the FR-1 change
smoke_test_steps.expected_outcome: Both suites pass, now asserting a returned object rather than a caught exception for the two landed=true codes.

Run the new FR-3 tests for coordinator-capacity-forecast.mjs, coordination-events.cjs's emitInertWorkerAlert, sweep-findings-sink.cjs, and kill-switch-writer.cjs against a synthetic delivered/parked outcome
